'''Captain of the Green''', a naval rank in the [[Ever Victorious Army]] of the [[Seanchan]].

==Rating==
The rank is equivalent to that of Banner General. It is above that of Ships Captain but below that of Captain of the Gold.  A Captain of the Green can command either a greatship or a small squadron of ships.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Captain of the Green}}

==Known Captains of the Green==
The only such Captain of the Green shown so far has been [[Egeanin Tamarath]], who has since been reduced from the [[Blood]].
